summary: Verified gap: 4 KBD stages gate on a cross-model judge; pmpo-skill-creator and native-agent have ZERO adversarial-review references, so generated skills and agents ship ungated. Work is wiring, not invention — dispatch-judge.sh, check-findings-sycophancy.sh (2-rejection cap), kbd-model-resolve.sh and the corrected findings schema all exist and are verified working. Part 2 researched adversarial review as a product: evidence is MIXED and partly contradicts the premise — NeurIPS 2025 spotlight proves debate alone induces a martingale and does not improve expected correctness (majority voting explains most MAD gains), and the human-AI literature documents automation bias and 'False Confirmation' over-reliance, which governs the personal-decision use case. Recommend the asymmetric producer->critic->judge design we already have, NOT a persona debate club, and an explicit refusal boundary for relationship/health decisions.
